name: water can
_note: stays when the water is gone; 'fill' at a water source you have explored (the spring, the river)

actions.label: fill
log: You submerge the can in the spring until clear water reaches its brim.
Fresh water enters the vessel with a hollow gurgling sound.
The can is filled from the spring and carefully closed against waste.

actions.label: fill
log: You immerse the vessel in the river until no bubbles rise from its mouth.
The stream presses against the can as it fills with running water.
You draw a full can from the river and fasten its lid firmly.
